_README: Manual corrections applied on top of the spreadsheet and the game data, by tools/build-roster.js.
Every entry needs a 'why' naming who verified it and how. This file exists so a correction
survives the next roster rebuild instead of being silently undone by it - and so nobody has to
guess later whether a number was measured or assumed.
TO MARK A SPELL AS LASTING FOREVER, add:  "set": { "infiniteDuration": true }
Search this file for infiniteDuration to see the ones already marked. A spell marked that way
shows a tile with no countdown that stays until its ended text arrives - it is for spells the
spreadsheet gives no duration BECAUSE they genuinely have none, as opposed to instants like
nukes and heals, which have no duration because they do not last at all.

Alacrity.why: Shara, 24 August 2026, measured live in-game: the roster (from the spreadsheet) gives 660s (11m), but the real base duration is 492s (8m12s) - confirmed by her stopwatching a cast with no AA/Exaltation bonus applied. The wrong base was compounding with the real AA+Exaltation multiplier (65% on her current settings) to show an 18-minute timer, which is correct math over a wrong number, not a scaling bug - see buffEngine.js's _scaledDuration and gotcha 25 in CLAUDE.md for the multiplier itself.

Yaulp.why: Shara, 20 August 2026: named as an example of a spell the spreadsheet gives no duration for because it genuinely lasts until dispelled or zoned, not because it is instant.

Yaulp II.why: A rank of Yaulp - identical landing and ended text - so it gets the same treatment. Marking only the base spell would leave the rank Shara actually casts still broken.

Yaulp III.why: A rank of Yaulp, same as Yaulp II - identical landing and ended text, so it gets the same treatment for the same reason. Leaving a rank unmarked would mean the spell behaves differently depending on which one the player happens to have scribed.

Fury.why: Shara, 20 August 2026: named alongside Yaulp as an example of a genuinely unlimited-duration spell.

Rage.why: Shara, 27 August 2026: "rage is permanent, too" - named directly while reviewing the Buff Planner, alongside Fury. Same berserk family, same "Your frenzy fades." ended text.

_CANDIDATES: NOT marked, because nobody has confirmed them - listed so the next person does not have to
rediscover them. Frenzy shares Fury's exact ended text ("Your frenzy fades.") and is the same
berserk family, so it is very likely infinite too. Shara named Fury and Rage, not Frenzy, and
guessing on her behalf is how a confident wrong number gets into the roster.
The wider list worth reviewing: 31 roster entries have a landing text, no duration, and are NOT
nukes or heals. Armor of Protection, Barbcoat, Wolf Form, Shrink, Feign Death, Banshee Aura,
O'Keil's Levity, Melanie's Mellifluous Motion, Minor Familiar, Cassindra's Chorus of Clarity.
RECAST TIMES are mined from the game data and are RIGHT MOST OF THE TIME BUT NOT ALWAYS.
Two were checked in game: Yaulp mined 18s and is 18s; Promised Renewal mined 21.5s and is 18s.
So one in two of the spot checks was wrong. Anything that shows a recast countdown should be
treated as a good default that the player can correct, not as measured truth, and a correction
belongs here as "reuseSec" rather than being typed into the roster.

Promised Renewal.why: RECAST: Shara verified 18s in game on 2026-08-20; the game data mines as 21.5s, which is wrong for this spell. Yaulp mined as 18s and she confirms 18s, so the recast field is right in general and wrong here in particular - do not 'correct' it globally on the strength of this one. DURATION: Shara verified 15s in game on 2026-08-19. The spreadsheet says 18s and the game data says 18s, so both sources are wrong for this spell on this server. It is also the only spell in category 'Delayed' and its effect is a Final Heal after a fuse - the 18s is the delay before the heal fires, not a buff duration, which is why it must not take the AA duration bonus either.

Mesmerize.why: Measured from the owner's own logs, and it agrees with her note-17 table (30/36/36/40) against the spreadsheet's 24. 189 Mesmerize wear-off lines were split by whether an "awakened by" break line sat within 1s: 99 breaks, 90 natural expiries. The natural expiries have a hard ceiling at exactly 30s - 13 sit on 30, none above it - which is what a real duration looks like. The 24s in the spreadsheet is wrong. Ranks II/III/V cannot be checked the same way: the owner has never cast them in any log.

Cassindra's Chant of Clarity.why: Shara, 28 August 2026: told directly it is 12 seconds. The spreadsheet gives it no duration, so it was showing a wrong value (1 minute) leaking in from elsewhere - shared landing text "Your mind clears." is also Brilliance's (see gotcha #15), and the bard-song modal duration is 12s besides.
